items.information:
# Southern Cubing welcomes you to Fort Worth for Southern Championship 2026!

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTI1NzUyLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--93ed8c64ab3237522f6a77aeaf7a38f7b6469e82/Southerns%202026%20Logo%202-05.png)

### **Please visit the [Key Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SouthernChampionship2026#63383-key-information) tab for an overview of everything Southern Champs 2026!**

The highest placing resident of Arkansas, Louisiana, Mississippi, Oklahoma or Texas in each event at this competition will be recognized as the Southern Champion! Check out the [Southern Championship Eligibility](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SouthernChampionship2026#63392-southern-champion-eligibility) tab for more information.

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [New Competitor Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SouthernChampionship2026#63385-new-competitor-information-and-faq) tab.

Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating.

This competition is organized by [Southern Cubing](https://www.southerncubing.com/) and supported by our [sponsors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SouthernChampionship2026#63391-sponsors-and-partners).

*New competitors are welcome — for Clock solvers, we highly encourage you to explore and take on the challenge of blindfolded and fewest moves!*

Valor de inscrição será de R$40,00 a ser pago via pix para **guriopen@gmail.com** (enviar o comprovante para o mesmo e-mail).

Por favor, caso você se inscreva mas decida não ir ao campeonato, por favor nos informe para que possamos programar corretamente a quantidade de competidores.
O competidor poderá se inscrever em quantas modalidades desejar. Pedimos que não se inscreva nas modalidades que não possui intenção de participar.

É imprescindível ter lido as regras da WCA (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

**English**
Registration fee is R$40,00 and payment with PIX method, to the key **guriopen@gmail.com** (send the receipt to this e-mail)

Please, if you register but decide not to come for the competition, please let us know so we can better figure out the number of competitor's to expect.
The competitor can register for every event that he wants, we just ask to not register to events you're not certain at participating.

Every competitor must have read WCA's Rules (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

### **대한민국 국적이 아닌 선수분들께서는 Korean Championship 2025에 참가 신청을 삼가주시기를 정중히 부탁드립니다.**

Korean Championship은 대한민국에서 열리는 가장 중요한 WCA 대회입니다.
본 대회는 대한민국 챔피언을 선발하기 위한 대회인 만큼, 챔피언 타이틀이 대한민국 국적자에게 주어지기를 희망합니다.
다른 대회에는 언제든지 참가를 환영합니다.

모든 종목의 결승 라운드에서는 대한민국 참가자를 위해 결승 라운드 참가 인원의 50% 또는 8명 중 더 적은 수가 우선 배정됩니다.
우선 배정이 적용되는 라운드에서는, 이전 라운드에서 진출하는 참가자 중 대한민국 참가자가 먼저 선발되며, 이후 다른 국적의 상위 참가자가 선발됩니다.

모든 참가자가 [WCA 규정](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/)을 숙지할 것을 강력히 권장합니다.

WCA 규정 [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/#1e2)와 [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/#1f2)에 따라, 모든 참가자는 운영진의 요청이 있을 시 스태프 업무를 수행해야 합니다.

---

### **The organization team kindly asks international competitors NOT to register for Korean Championship 2025.**

Korean Championship is the most important WCA competition in Korea.
As this competition is held to determine the national champion, we hope that the championship title will be awarded to competitors with Korean nationality.
You are always welcome to participate in other competitions.

For the final round of all events, 50% or up to 8 of the finalist spots (whichever is smaller) will be reserved for competitors representing the Republic of Korea.
In rounds with reserved spots, advancing competitors will first include the top Korean competitors from the previous round, followed by the highest-ranked competitors of other nationalities.

All competitors are strongly encouraged to be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

According to WCA Regulations [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2), all competitors must perform staff duties upon request from the organizers.

Mistrzostwa Polski w Speedcubingu to najważniejsza impreza sezonu w kalendarzu każdego polskiego speedcubera. Od 2005 roku nieprzerwanie przyciąga najlepszych zawodników, którzy w atmosferze ducha fair play walczą o tytuł mistrza kraju we wszystkich oficjalnych konkurencjach

![](https://i.imgur.com/i1ldA95.png)
Polish Championships is the most important competition in calendar of any Polish speedcuber. Since 2005 it brings best competitors who fight for Polish Champion titles in all official events in fair play atmosphere.

### **The organization team kindly asks international competitors NOT to register for the Polish Speedcubing Championship 2025 in Warsaw.**
In our view, a national championship should be reserved for the citizens of that country. This is just one of around 70 competitions held in Poland each year – you are more than welcome to attend any of the others.

Varmt välkomna till den fjärde deltävlingen i höstsäsongen av Uppsalaligan 2025! Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter samt oavsett tidigare tävlingserfarenhet (eller tidigare deltagande i serien). A warm welcome to the fourth competition in the autumn season of Uppsalaligan 2025! Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior competition experience (or participation earlier in the league). Please read through all the tabs on this page so you don't miss any important information.

You are welcome to join the Facebook Group [Rubik's Cube Solvers British Columbia](https://www.facebook.com/groups/8336572494). To get updates about future BC and/or Canadian competitions, join the [Speedcubing Canada mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz).

Please **review all of the tabs listed on this website**. This competition **ONLY HAS FEWEST MOVES & BLINDFOLDED EVENTS**, and is **NOT A REGULAR COMPETITION**.

Do note that we may run ahead of or behind schedule, particularly for events in the afternoon **please be ready at least 30 minutes in advance** just in case.

**Notice of filming and photography:**
Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

**Health and Safety:**
Masks will be optional at this event. Please stay home if you are sick or feeling unwell.

Registration is **free** for **new competitors** as well as [**AFS members**](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/association/adhesion), no matter your citizenship or place of residence. Otherwise registration costs 5€.
Please read the **registration conditions, the [FAQ](#64234-foire-aux-questions-frequently-asked-questions) and the [AFS tutorials](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/speedcubing/tutos) carefully**.
Make sure to read the [Schedule](#competition-schedule) tab.

items.information:
**Quiet Events Only**

The only events held at this competition are blindfolded and fewest move events, which require a significant amount of concentration. All attendees, including competitors and guests, are asked to remain AS QUIET AS POSSIBLE throughout the day to allow competitors to concentrate.

**Note for New Competitors**

Although first-timers are welcome to compete if they can solve puzzles blindfolded, this competition is not the traditional WCA competition experience. Please consider registering for another competition, such as [UMBC Fall 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UMBCFall2025), if this one isn't for you.

items.name: Please Be Quiet Waterloo 2025
items.information:
[![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/)

## Please Be Quiet

This is not a typical speed solving competition, as ***blindfolded events***  and ***Fewest Moves*** are the only events. Blindfolded events require a significant amount of learning, practice and concentration. Fewest Moves is an exam-style event in which competitors spend up to one hour finding the shortest solution they can and writing it down on paper. 

All attendees, including competitors and guests, are asked to please remain quiet at this competition to allow competitors to concentrate.

If you are looking to compete in the traditional 3x3x3 Cube event or other timed events, please look for [another competition in Canada](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada).

## Note for New Competitors

Although first-timers are welcome to compete if they know how to solve puzzles blindfolded and/or how to write out solutions on paper (please note Regulation [2k6](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2k6)), this might not be the best experience for new competitors. Please consider registering for [another competition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada) if this one isn't for you.

You can also follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements.

## Notice of Filming and Photography

Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.name: Blind Marathon in Rzeszów 2025
items.information:
Zapraszamy na Blind Marathon in Rzeszów 2025 – zawody stworzone specjalnie dla fanów konkurencji blindowych! 🙈
To wydarzenie to prawdziwy maraton: w programie znajdziecie wyłącznie blindy, a dodatkowo coś naprawdę rzadkiego – dwie rundy dużych kostek bez patrzenia. To świetna okazja, by sprawdzić swoją wytrzymałość, koncentrację i zmierzyć się z wyzwaniem, którego nie spotyka się na co dzień.
Jeśli blindy to Wasza pasja (albo chcecie wreszcie poczuć ich klimat na poważnie) – widzimy się w Rzeszowie!

---

We are excited to invite you to Blind Marathon in Rzeszów 2025 – a competition dedicated entirely to blindfolded events! 🙈
This is a true marathon: the schedule includes only blindfolded events, and on top of that something truly rare – two rounds of big cube blindfolded solving. It’s a perfect opportunity to test your endurance, focus, and face a challenge you don’t get to see very often.
If blindfolded solving is your passion (or you simply want to dive into its atmosphere for real) – see you in Rzeszów!

El reto más mental del speedcubing regresa a Tijuana. FMC Tijuas III 2025 evoluciona con la llegada de Big Blind. Tres intentos, máxima concentración y ahora también resolución a ciegas. Aquí no importa la velocidad, sino la estrategia.

# Welcome to Dare to DR Rizal 2025!
# 
Dare to DR Rizal 2025 is an official WCA competition featuring a wide variety of events, including **3x3, 5x5, 7x7, Pyraminx, Skewb, 4x4 Blindfolded, 3x3 Multi-Blind**, and highlights **3x3 Fewest Moves** as the main event.

This competition also **aims to encourage more cubers to explore and learn Domino Reduction (DR)**—the most advanced method currently used in Fewest Moves solving.

* **3x3 Multi-Blind** is limited to **25 competitors,** and it's on a first-come and first-served basis.
* **2-Person Mini Guilford** and **Master Magic** will also be held as unofficial events.

For more information, please visit the [Unofficial Events](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DaretoDRRizal2025#61609-must-read-unofficial-events) tab.

items.information:

## [EN]

### Please be Quiet

All of the events at this competition are ***blindfolded events***, which require a significant amount of learning, practice and concentration. All attendees, including competitors and guests, are asked to please remain quiet at this competition to allow competitors to concentrate.

### Note for New Competitors

Although first-timers are welcome to compete if they know how to solve puzzles blindfolded (please note Regulation [2k6](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2k6)), this might not be the best experience for new competitors. Please consider registering for [another competition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada) if this one isn't for you.

### Registration Reminders

**Registration will close on Friday September 19th 2025 at 10 pm (8 days before the competition)**. You must register and pay the registration fee before this date in order for your registration to be accepted. Late registrations will not be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. If you have any questions, please contact us using the *Contact Organization team* link at the top of this page.

### Competitor Requirements

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors should be familiar with the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). For a summary of the most important regulations, please refer to the following resources: [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf) & [The basics of an official WCA competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vz1V0Gv0qX0). If you are a new competitor, this video explains what to expect at your first competition: [What to expect at your first competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xK2ycvTfgUY).

### Mailing List

Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements.

### Notice of Filming and Photography

Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

## [FR]

### Silence s'il vous plaît

Toutes les épreuves de cette compétition sont des épreuves ***avec les yeux bandés***, qui nécessitent une quantité importante d'apprentissage, d'entraînement et de concentration. Toutes les personnes présentes, y compris les participants et les accompagnateurs, sont priées de ne pas faire de bruit afin de permettre aux participants de se concentrer.

### Note pour les nouveaux compétiteurs

Bien que les novices soient les bienvenus s'ils savent résoudre des casse-tête les yeux bandés (voir le règlement [2k6](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2k6)), il se peut que cette compétition ne soit pas la meilleure expérience pour les nouveaux compétiteurs. Veuillez envisager de vous inscrire à [une autre compétition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada) si celle-ci ne vous convient pas.

### Rappels concernant l'inscription

**Les inscriptions seront clôturées le vendredi 19 septembre 2025 à 22h (8 jours avant la compétition)**. Vous devez vous inscrire et payer les frais d'inscription avant cette date pour que votre inscription soit acceptée. Les inscriptions en retard ne seront pas acceptées. Voir les sections **Liste des compétiteurs** et **Liste d'attente** au bas de cette page pour plus de détails. Si vous avez des questions, veuillez nous contacter en utilisant le lien *Contact Équipe organisatrice* en haut de cette page.

### Exigences pour les compétiteurs

Cette compétition est reconnue comme une compétition officielle de la World Cube Association. Par conséquent, tous les compétiteurs doivent être familiers avec les [règlements de la WCA] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Pour un résumé des règlements les plus importants, veuillez vous référer aux ressources suivantes: [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf) & [Les bases d'une compétition officielle de la WCA](https://youtu.be/LH3QG7krdgc?feature=shared). Pour les nouveaux compétiteurs, cette vidéo explique à quoi s'attendre lors de votre première compétition: [À quoi s'attendre pour votre première compétition](https://youtu.be/yYZHzTc0GMc?feature=shared). Veuillez consulter les onglets pour plus d'informations sur la compétition.

### Liste de diffusion

Veuillez suivre [Speedcubing Canada] (https://speedcubingcanada.org/fr)  sur les réseaux sociaux et/ou [vous inscrire à notre liste de diffusion](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) pour vous tenir au courant des annonces de compétitions.

### Avis de droit à l'image

Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques.

* O pagamento da inscrição deve ser feito antecipadamente, todas as instruções se encontram na aba de *inscrever-se* do campeonato.
* A inscrição **NÃO** será aceita até que o pagamento e o comprovante sejam enviados. Sem isso sua inscrição não será aprovada e você não poderá competir.

***A inscrição só será efetivada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento. Assim, as inscrições estarão limitadas aos 60 primeiros pagantes. Caso o número de inscritos exceda este limite, será usada uma lista de espera de acordo com a ordem do pagamento.***

--------------------

## English

* The payment of the registration fee must be made in advance. All the relevant instructions can be found under the *register* tab.
* The registration **WILL NOT** be accepted until the payment is done and the receipt is sent. Otherwise, your registration will not be accepted and you will not be allowed to competed at the day of the competition.

***Registration will only be confirmed at the WCA website after payment confirmation. Thus, registrations will be limited to the first 60 payers. If the number of registrations exceeds this limit, a waiting list will be put in place ordered by de date of payment.***

items.name: Swisscubing Cup Mental Breakdown II 2025
items.information:
Der Swisscubing Cup Mental Breakdown ist Teil des Swisscubing Cup 2025. Dieser besteht aus mehreren Competitions über das ganze Jahr verteilt. 
Jeder ist willkommen, unabhängig davon ob Interesse besteht, am Swisscubing Cup Finale teilzunehmen.

**Punkte für die Qualifikation für das Swisscubing Cup 2025 Finale können bei dieser Competition nur in den folgenden Disziplinen gesammelt werden:
4-Blind, 5-Blind, Multiblind, FMC.**
Alle anderen Disziplinen an dieser Competition sind nicht Teil des Swisscubing Cups.

______________________________________________________________________________________________

The Swisscubing Cup Mental Breakdown is part of the Swisscubing Cup 2025, made of multiple competitions during the whole year. 
Everyone is welcome to compete, regardless of whether they are interested in taking part in the Swisscubing Cup final.

**Points for qualifying for the Swisscubing Cup 2025 Finals can only be collected at this competition in the following events: 
4-Blind, 5-Blind, Multiblind, FMC.**
All other events at this competition are not part of the Swisscubing Cup.

items.name: Svealandsmästerskapet 2025
items.information:
Välkomna till Svealandsmästerskapet 2025! 

Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter. 

Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information.

Alla som vill är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett tidigare erfarenhet eller var i världen du bor. Notera dock att det endast är deltagare som bor i Svealand som kan vinna titlar och priser på Svealandsmästerskapet, läs mer om detta under fliken "[Regionala Mästerskap](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Svealandsmasterskapet2025#60493-regionala-masterskap-2025-regional-championships-2025)".

-----

Welcome to Svealandsmästerskapet 2025!

Everyone is welcome to participate, whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes.

We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information.

Anyone who wants is warmly welcome to participate, regardless of previous experience or where in the world you live. Note, however, that only competitors who live in Svealand can win titles and prizes at the Svealand Championship, read more about this under the tab "[Regional Championships](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Svealandsmasterskapet2025#60493-regionala-masterskap-2025-regional-championships-2025)".

## Welcome to Rubik's UK Championship 2025!
### This year's UK National Championship!

#### Please read ALL tabs before registering.

##### Spectators are welcome to attend for free. There's no need to pre-book - feel free to drop in whenever you wish!

**Free T-Shirt:** By registering and attending Rubik's UK Championship 2025, you'll receive a Rubik's UK Championship 2025 T-shirt as a memento! **Please fill in your registration comment with your T-shirt size.**

**Newcomers:** Unfortunately, **this competition is not open to first-time competitors**. If you have not been to a competition before but would like to attend this one, you must attend another competition first. You can see all upcoming UK competitions [here](https://wca.ukca.org).

**Qualification Requirements:** If you do not meet the qualification requirements outlined in the [Events tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksUKChampionship2025#competition-events) in an official WCA competition by August 10th you will not be eligible to compete in those events. You will not be able to add events to your registration which you do not qualify for, but can update your registration if you later qualify for them. Please note that **the only qualification for 2x2, 3x3, Pyraminx, and Skewb is to have any average in the event.**

**Final Round Advancements:** The top 6 UK competitors will be [guaranteed to progress](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full/#9p2b) into the finals for all events, in addition to the top 10 remaining best competitors of any region. For 3x3, the top 8 UK competitors will be guaranteed to progress into the finals.

**Fewest Moves:** FMC will **not** be held at this competition. To compete for the national champion title for FMC, you must compete at the Rubik's UK Championship FMC 2025. The winner of the FMC competition will be awarded their prize during the awards at Rubik's UK Championship 2025.

**Prizes Eligiblity:** As this is the UK National Championship, only competitors who represent the United Kingdom will be eligible for prizes. The competition remains open for all nationalities to compete.

**Filming and Photography:** Filming and photography will take place at the event. By entering the event premises, you acknowledge that you have been informed you may be photographed and recorded for media to be used by the UKCA and its partners.

items.name: CF Goes Crazy Brzeziny 2025
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTA2MDU5LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--9099699a415c4020c460b8848aaf69949ce677ba/goes%20crazy%20wca.png)

Drodzy,
ekipa Cube Factory pragnie serdecznie zaprosić na jedyne w swoim rodzaju zawody side'owe!
Chcemy dać Wam możliwość sprawdzenia swoich sił w konkurencjach blindowych oraz Big Cube'ach bez ciążącego na Was widma restrykcyjnych cut-offów, które zastąpione zostały wysokimi limitami kumulowanymi. Dzięki temu mniej zaawansowani zawodnicy będą mieli szansę na uzyskanie wyników których wcześniej nie byli w stanie osiągnąć! 

Oszaleliśmy? Być może 😉

Dear All,
Cube Factory Team invites you to a unique side-events competition!
We want to give you a chance to try your luck in big cubes and blinfolded events, without the strict cut-offs looming over you. Instead, we have replaced them with very generous cumulative time limits. This way, less experienced competitors will finally have a shot at achieving results that used to be out of reach! 

Have we Gone Crazy? Maybe 😉

----

**WAŻNE / IMPORTANT**

Ze względu na duży limit kumulowany dla konkurencji 4x4x4 Blindfolded oraz 5x5x5 Blindfolded doświadczeni zawodnicy mają możliwość rozpoczęcia swoich prób w trakcie trwania rundy. W takim wypadku, zgodnie z punktem 2u2) regulaminu WCA, zawodnikowi zostanie zmniejszony limit kumulowany o czas odpowiadający czasowi spóźnienia.

Konkurencja 3x3x3 wiele kostek bez patrzenia posiada oddzielny limit zawodników, który wynosi 16.
Konkurencja 4x4x4  bez patrzenia posiada oddzielny limit zawodników, który wynosi 16.
Konkurencja 5x5x5  bez patrzenia posiada oddzielny limit zawodników, który wynosi 16.

3x3x3 Multi-Blind has a separate competitiors limit of 16.
4x4x4 Blindfolded has a separate competitiors limit of 16.
5x5x5 Blindfolded has a separate competitiors limit of 16.

## 🇳🇴 Informasjon
Velkommen til Norgesmesterskapet i Kubing 2025, denne gangen hold i Lierskogen. Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta, uavhengig av nasjonalitet.

### Førstegangsdeltakere
Førstegangsdeltakere er veldig velkommen til å delta på NM. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. Vi ber alle førstegangsdeltakere vennligst lese [Førstegangsdeltakere-fanen](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorwegianChampionship2025#55231-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors).

## 🇬🇧 Information
Welcome to the Norwegian Cubing Championship of 2025, held in Lierskogen. The competition is open to all who wish to compete regardless of nationality.

### First-Time Competitors
First-time competitors are very welcome to compete in the Norwegian Championship. There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition. We would like to ask all first-time competitors to read the [First-Time Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorwegianChampionship2025#55231-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors) tab.

Competidores participando pela primeira vez precisam apresentar na competição um documento oficial com nome, data de nascimento e nacionalidade. Sugerimos que você chegue 30 minutos antes do horário da modalidade em que vai competir.

Ao se inscrever, você autoriza que a ABRACM, a WCA e seus parceiros utilizem a sua imagem nas fotos e filmagens que forem feitas no evento, de forma gratuita, inclusive para fins comerciais.

---

Your registration will only be approved on the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information in the [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CampeonatoBrasileiro2025/register) tab. If you have any problem registering, watch [this video](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=znioC-4r06ap7Urn&t=410).

Competitors participating for the first time must present an official document with their name, date of birth and nationality. We suggest you arrive 30 minutes before the event you're competing in is scheduled to begin.

By registering, you authorize ABRACM, WCA, and their partners to use your image in the photos and videos taken at the event, free of charge, including for commercial purposes.

By registering, you authorize ABRACM, WCA, and their partners to use your image in the photos and videos taken at the event, free of charge, including for commercial purposes.

##### **German**
Willkommen zurück beim Zauberwürfel Wettbewerb in Köln! Zum dritten Mal findet Kölner Kubing statt. Seid dabei, knackt eure Rekorde, egal ob Einsteiger oder Profi – habt Spaß an diesem Turnier. Schnappt euch euren Würfel und seid Teil dieses einzigartigen Events!

**Wichtig!**
Bei den letzten Competitions von Köln hatten wir in den ersten 5 Minuten über 150 Anmeldungen. Sorgt bitte dafür, dass ihr die Teilnahmegebühr **vor** der Online-Anmeldung bezahlt. Wenn Ihr überweisen müsst, macht das bitte 2-3 Tage vorher, damit die Zahlung rechtzeitig bei uns ankommt. Wir gehen wieder davon aus, dass auch Kölner Kubing 2025 innerhalb weniger Minuten voll sein wird!


**English**
Welcome back to the Rubik's Cube competition in Cologne! Kölner Kubing is taking place for the third time. Be there, break your records, whether you are a beginner or a pro - have fun at this tournament. Grab your cube and be part of this unique event!

**Important!**
In the last competitions in Cologne we had over 150 registrations in the first 5 minutes. Please make sure that you pay the entry fee **before** you register online. If you have to pay by bank transfer, please do so 2-3 days in advance so that we receive the payment in time. We assume that Kölner Kubing 2025 will again be full within a few minutes!

**@riocubolympics**

## Please Be Quiet

This isn't your typical speed solving competition as ***blindfolded events*** are the only events. Blindfolded events require a significant amount of learning, practice and concentration. All attendees, including competitors and guests, are asked to please remain quiet at this competition to allow competitors to concentrate.

If you are looking to compete in the traditional 3x3x3 Cube event or other timed events, please look for [another competition in Canada](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada).

## FMC Canada 2025

We will take a break in the middle of the day to hold [FMC Canada 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCCanada2025) at the same venue. You may compete in both competitions, but **you must register for each competition separately**.

## Note for New Competitors

Although first-timers are welcome to compete if they know how to solve puzzles blindfolded (please note Regulation [2k6](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2k6)), this might not be the best experience for new competitors. Please consider registering for [another competition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada) if this one isn't for you.

You can also follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements.

## Registration Reminders

You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details.

## Notice of Filming and Photography

Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.information:
CubingZA is very proud to announce the South African National Championships for 2025! Compete against South Africa's fastest speedcubers and break some records!

This is an open championship - meaning anyone is eligible to compete. **All WCA events** except **FMC** will be held, with winners in each event being declared the 2025 South African Champion for that event.

Don't forget that to participate you need to register for the competition in the "Register" tab, and make payment by buying a ticket on our payment page.

## **[Payment Link](https://reg.cubingza.org/product/cubingza-nationals-2025/) <-------Pay Here**

**SPECTATORS**
Competitors are allowed to bring up to 3 guests as spectators. Spectators attend for free.

items.information:
### [FR]

Pensez à consulter les onglets, en particulier celui du [planning](#competition-schedule).

**Les étudiants de l'ÉTS peuvent s'inscrire sans frais**.  Si vous êtes étudiant de l'ÉTS, inscrivez votre courriel finissant par estmtl.net dans la zone des commentaires lorsque vous vous inscrivez puis **ne payez pas les frais d'inscription**.  
**Vous ne pouvez pas vous inscrire à la fois au 5x5 à l'aveugle et au megaminx**. Vous devez choisir au maximum un des deux. Si vous mettez les deux, votre inscription ne sera pas acceptée.

### Avis de droit à l'image
Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques.

---

### [EN]

Make sure to read the information in the tabs, especially the one with the [schedule](#competition-schedule).

**ETS students may compete for free**. If you are an ETS student, write your email address ending with etsmtl.net in the registration comments and submit your registration **without paying the registration fee**.
**You may not register for both 5x5 blindfolded and megaminx**. You must choose at most one of the two. If you put both, your registration will not be accepted.

### Notice of Filming and Photography
Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

El Corazón de la Axarquía 2025 is being held in honour of Owen Pérez, a young cuber who sadly suddenly passed away in 2024. Owen competed in the UMA Open 2023 and the Ecija Open 2024. As well as being a talented cuber, he was a smart, creative and fun boy, and he is greatly missed.

items.name: Mental Breakdown Landvetter 2025
items.information:
Välkomna till Mental Breakdown Landvetter 2025!

Detta är en lite annorlunda tävling, med bara de mer avancerade grenarna som på årets SM kommer ha kvalgränser. Här är alltså en utmärkt chans att kvala in till dem!
Därmed är det inte en tävling som typiskt sett passar nybörjare, men om men är flink på att lösa med ögonbindel eller FMC så är man givetvis varmt välkommen oavsett tidigare tävlingserfarenhet. 

Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information.

-----

Welcome to Mental Breakdown Landvetter 2025!

This is a slightly different competition, with only the more advanced events that will have qualification limits at this year's Swedish Championship. So here is an excellent chance to qualify for them!
That also means it is not a competition that typically suits beginners, but if you are good at blindfolded solving or FMC, you are of course welcome regardless of previous competition experience. 

We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information.

- The competition will begin at the scheduled start time.
- Lunch will end at the scheduled time. 
- Events will begin as soon as the previous event is wrapping up. Exception: All First Round events will not start more than 20 minutes early. 
- Competitors may not compete in an event if they miss last call for that event. In general, last call is a few minutes after the last group is called.

**¡Te invitamos al increíble Baja Spring 2025!** ¡El primer torneo de 3 días en Baja California que NO te puedes perder! Ven a disfrutar de todas las categorías de NxN y sumérgete en la emoción de los eventos silenciosos. ¡Baja Cubing y el Museo del Trompo se unen para llevar el speedcubing al siguiente nivel en Baja California! ¡Será un evento épico que marcará historia, con adrenalina, velocidad y mucha diversión! ¡Nos vemos en Baja Spring 2025!

Esta es una competencia avalada por la WCA, por lo que todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados con el [reglamento](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

**We invite you to the incredible Baja Spring 2025!** The first 3-day tournament in Baja California that you CANNOT miss! Come enjoy all the NxN categories and dive into the excitement of the silent events. Baja Cubing and the Museum of the Spinning Top are joining forces to take speedcubing to the next level in Baja California! It will be an epic event that will make history, full of adrenaline, speed, and tons of fun! See you at Baja Spring 2025!

This is a WCA-approved competition, so all competitors must be familiar with the [regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

items.information:
De derde Mental Breakdown competitie in Nederland! Op het programma staan de blind-onderdelen, FMC en big cubes. Een wedstrijd voor de fanatiekelingen dus. Het main event is 3x3x3 blindfolded.

**Let op: Dit is een wedstrijd voor stille events en is niet geschikt voor nieuwkomers. Er zullen GEEN 3×3 of andere gebruikelijke events zijn, dus als je NIET geïnteresseerd bent in geblinddoekt oplossen of "big cubes", overweeg dan om je niet in te schrijven.**

---

The third Mental Breakdown competition in the Netherlands! On the schedule you will find the blind events, FMC and big cubes. A competition for the real fanatic. The main event is 3x3x3 blindfolded.

**NOTE: This is a competition for silent events and it is not suitable for newcomers. There will be NO 3x3 or other regular events, so if you are not interested in blindfolded solving or "big cubes" please consider not signing up.**

Get ready for a day of big cubes and blindfolded solving in San Jose!

# This competition does NOT have 3x3x3 Cube. If you'd like to compete in 3x3, see [Bay Area Side Events Day 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BayAreaSideEventsDay2025).

All attendees are required to be quiet during blindfolded events, as these events require lots of concentration. If you would like to talk during a blindfolded event, please step outside of the venue first.

**Competition Day Timing**
- The competition will begin at the scheduled start time.
- Lunch will end at the scheduled time.
- Events will begin as soon as the previous event is wrapping up. Exception: All First Round events will not start more than 20 minutes early.
- Competitors may not compete in an event if they miss last call for that event. In general, last call is a few minutes after the last group is called.

items.name: Wellington Mind Games 2025
items.information:
Wellington Mind Games 2025 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. It is focused on some of the more mentally demanding events, that are given less of a focus in normal competitions - blindfolded and fewest moves solving, specifically.

The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience or skill. There will also be event-based time limits in place, to ensure we stay on schedule, especially given the time taken by fewest moves solving. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations.

**The main event of this competition is Fewest Moves**

As the venue has a limited size, it will be permitted a single guest per competitor, without any possibility of the addition of other guests.
Competitor limit: 20

REGISTRO
A participação nessa competição requer do competidor o conhecimento dos seguintes requisitos, sem o cumprimento destes, a inscrição não será aceita:

Estar familiarizado com o Regulamento da WCA;
Se inscrever através do site da WCA, realizar o pagamento de forma antecipada e mandar o comprovante para o organizador através do e-mail (matcasvia@gmail.com) indicando o nome completo do participante. Detalhes sobre o pagamento da inscrição abaixo.

Aguardar até que o registro eletrônico seja aceito. Caso não participe mesmo com o pagamento, não haverá devolução do dinheiro.
Há um limite de 20 competidores
Outras informações adicionais verifique no site da WCA ou entre em contato com o organizador através do e-mail (matcasvia@gmail.com).

REGISTRATION
The participation in this competition requires the comprehension and acceptance of the following requirements, without fulfilling these requirements, the registration will not be accepted:

Register through the WCA website, pay in advance and send proof to the organizer via email (matcasvia@gmail.com) indicating the participant's full name. More details about the payment below;

Wait for your registration to be approved online. In the case of not participating and having already paid the registration, no money will be returned.
There will be a limit of 20 competitors.
For additional information, check the WCA website or contact the organizer via email, (matcasvia@gmail.com)

Mira Labs is excited to announce our inaugural WCA competition, **Mira Labs Cubing Scientists in Bacolod 2025**!

This event welcomes participants of all ages and skill levels, with generous cut-off times to encourage broader participation. The 3x3x3 cube, our main event, will feature three thrilling rounds, while the 2x2x2 cube will have two rounds. To revive the community’s interest in specialized categories, we’re also offering two rounds for Clock and Square-1, while the remaining events will each feature a single, intense round.

By registering, competitors and their guests—including but not limited to family members, friends, and guardians—acknowledge that the organizing bodies, their staff, and affiliated individuals will not be liable for any injuries, loss of personal belongings, or emotional distress resulting from participation in this event.

Please be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full/) before participating in this event.

### 주최 측에서 발송하는 이메일을 꼭 확인 하시기를 바랍니다.

모든 참가자는 [WCA 규정](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/)을 숙지하여야 합니다.

WCA 규정 [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2)와 [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2)에 따라, 모든 참가자는 운영진의 요청이 있을 시 스태프 업무를 수행해야 합니다.

원할한 스태프 업무 수행을 위하여 [스태프 규정 영상](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz)을 시청하여 주십시오.
원할한 기록 측정을 위하여 [WCA 규정 및 타이머 사용 안내 영상](https://youtu.be/bKzz_YBVi7s?si=W0dGxSrqfmIaLJF1)을 시청하여 주십시오.

___
# There is no 3x3x3 event at this competition.
# There is a [Spectator Restriction](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SilentKoreaWinter2024#48982-spectator-restriction).

All competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

items.information:
### On the spot registration is open for 2x2x2, 3x3x3, Pyraminx, and Skewb events only.


Kejuaraan Speedcubing Nasional untuk Indonesia pada tahun 2024. Peserta dari segala usia dan kewarganegaraan dipersilakan untuk mengikuti.
Harap diperhatikan tentang limit dan cutoff untuk setiap event, karena lebih ketat daripada kompetisi biasanya.

Akan ada **2 jenis pemenang** dalam kompetisi ini:
**Kategori Terbuka** - 3 pemenang teratas kompetisi tanpa memandang kewarganegaraan
**Kategori Indonesia** - 3 pemenang teratas yang mewakili Indonesia di setiap kategori

Peserta atau pendamping harus setuju bahwa penyelenggara, NSA, dan WCA tidak bertanggung jawab atas cedera pribadi, atau kerusakan atau kehilangan barang pribadi anda yang diakibatkan oleh partisipasi Anda dalam acara ini.
Untuk informasi lebih lanjut, silakan periksa **Persyaratan Pendaftaran.**
Biaya pendaftaran termasuk, Sertifikat Partisipasi, Lanyard, dan Name Tag.
Silahkan melakukan registrasi di website WCA dan konfirmasi di [form ini](https://forms.gle/h89T8gudSJRxWPaF9)

*Harap perhatikan jadwal selama periode pendaftaran terbuka karena dapat berubah tergantung pada jumlah orang yang mendaftar untuk setiap acara.*

---

### Registrasi OTS dibuka hanya untuk cabang 2x2x2, 3x3x3, Pyraminx, dan Skewb.

The National Speedcubing Championship for Indonesia in 2024. Competitiors of all ages and nationality are welcomed to join.
Please notice the time limit and cutoff on each events, as they are stricter than regular competitions.

There will be **2 types of winners** in this competition:
**Open Category** - Top 3 winners of the competition regardless of nationality
**Indonesian Category** - Top 3 winners representing the Indonesia in each category

Competitor or guardian must agree that the organizers, NSA and WCA shall not be liable for any personal injury, property damage or loss resulting from your participation of this event.
For more information, please check the **Registration Requirements.**
Registration fee includes, Certificate of Participation, Lanyard and Name Tag.
Please register in the WCA website and confirm your registration by filling out [this form](https://forms.gle/h89T8gudSJRxWPaF9)

*Please keep an eye on our schedule during the open registration period as it may change depending on the number of people registering for each event.*

This year, hosted at the Centro Boliviano-Americano in the city of Santa Cruz de la Sierra, this tournament will provide a unique venue for all competitors to showcase their skills and speed in the different categories.

This competition is open to all public.

This competition is organized in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/)

**Adding/Dropping Events**

- Competitors may request via the contact form to be added to more events BEFORE registration closes.
- Competitors may not add events after registration closes.
- Competitors may request via the contact form to remove events from their registration. It is also acceptable to not show up for any event you do not wish to compete in, although it is not encouraged.
- Competitors may also adjust their registration details by themselves, without prior approval until the registration deadline

If Registration fills up, we will place competitors on a waitlist. In order to get on the waitlist, you must register and pay. You are not on the waitlist until you pay the registration fee. If you do not make it off of the waitlist, you will be fully refunded. If a competitor drops out, the first person on the waitlist will replace them. People can be replaced up until the registration close date indicated above.

*In a catastrophic event where the event will be compromised and cancelled, a full refund shall be offered to all competitors, in contrast to the typical 95% registration refunds.*

items.information:
[![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/)

## Please Be Quiet

This isn't your typical speed solving competition as ***blindfolded events*** are the only events. Blindfolded events require a significant amount of learning, practice and concentration. All attendees, including competitors and guests, are asked to please remain quiet at this competition to allow competitors to concentrate.

If you are looking to compete in the traditional 3x3x3 Cube event or other timed events, please look for [another competition in Canada](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada).

## FMC Canada 2024

We will take a break in the middle of the day to hold [FMC Canada 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCCanada2024) at the same venue. You may compete in both competitions, but **you must register for each competition separately**.

## Note for New Competitors

Although first-timers are welcome to compete if they know how to solve puzzles blindfolded (please note Regulation [2k6](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2k6)), this might not be the best experience for new competitors. Please consider registering for [another competition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada) if this one isn't for you.

You can also follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements.

## Registration Reminders

You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details.

## Notice of Filming and Photography

Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

## [EN]

### Please be quiet

All of the events at this competition are ***blindfolded events***, which require a significant amount of learning, practice and concentration. All attendees, including competitors and guests, are asked to please remain quiet at this competition to allow competitors to concentrate.

### Note for new competitors

Although first-timers are welcome to compete if they know how to solve puzzles blindfolded (please note Regulation [2k6](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2k6)), this might not be the best experience for new competitors. Please consider registering for [another competition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada) if this one isn't for you.

### Registration Reminders

You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details.

### Competitor Requirements

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors should be familiar with the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). For a summary of the most important regulations, please refer to the following resources: [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf) & [The basics of an official WCA competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vz1V0Gv0qX0). 

If you are a new competitor, this video expains what to expect at your first competition: [What to expect at your first competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xK2ycvTfgUY). Please see tabs for more information about the competition.

### Mailing List

Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements.

### Notice of Filming and Photography

Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

## [FR]

### Silence s'il vous plaît

Toutes les épreuves de cette compétition sont des épreuves ***avec les yeux bandés***, qui nécessitent une quantité importante d'apprentissage, d'entraînement et de concentration. Toutes les personnes présentes, y compris les participants et les accompagnateurs, sont priées de ne pas faire de bruit afin de permettre aux participants de se concentrer.

### Note pour les nouveaux compétiteurs

Bien que les novices soient les bienvenus s'ils savent résoudre des casse-tête les yeux bandés (voir le règlement [2k6](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2k6)) ou le défi des moindres mouvements (3x3 Résolution optimisée), il se peut que cette compétition ne soit pas la meilleure expérience pour les nouveaux compétiteurs. Veuillez envisager de vous inscrire à [une autre compétition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada) si celle-ci ne vous convient pas.

### Rappels concernant l'inscription

Vous devez vous inscrire *et payer les frais d'inscription* avant que votre inscription ne soit acceptée. Les inscriptions non payées ne seront pas acceptées. Voir les sections **Liste des compétiteurs** et **Liste d'attente** au bas de cette page pour plus de détails.

### Exigences pour les compétiteurs

Cette compétition est reconnue comme une compétition officielle de la World Cube Association. Par conséquent, tous les compétiteurs doivent être familiers avec les [règlements de la WCA] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Pour un résumé des règlements les plus importants, veuillez vous référer aux ressources suivantes: [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf) & [The basics of an official WCA competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vz1V0Gv0qX0) (des sous-titres en français disponibles). 

Pour les nouveaux compétiteurs, cette vidéo explique à quoi s'attendre lors de votre première compétition: [What to expect at your first competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xK2ycvTfgUY) (des sous-titres en français disponibles). Veuillez consulter les onglets pour plus d'informations sur la compétition.

### Liste de diffusion

Veuillez suivre [Speedcubing Canada] (https://speedcubingcanada.org/fr)  sur les réseaux sociaux et/ou [vous inscrire à notre liste de diffusion](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) pour vous tenir au courant des annonces de compétitions.

### Avis de droit à l'image

Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques.

items.information:
Els socis de l'ACSC reben un descompte del 15% després de la competició. Pots fer-te soci de l'ACSC [aquí](https://linktr.ee/speedcubingcat).

Aquesta competició no té una categoria principal. El guanyador de la competició es decidirà mitjançant el “Sum of Ranks”. Això consisteix a sumar totes les posicions en què ha quedat un competidor a totes les categories, i qui obtingui el nombre més baix serà qui millor ha actuat en tot el llarg de la competició i, per tant, el guanyador.
​
Los socios de la ACSC reciben un descuento del 15% después de la competición. Puedes hacerte socio de la ACSC [aquí](https://linktr.ee/speedcubingcat).

Esta competición no tiene una categoría principal. El ganador de la competición se decidirá mediante “Sum of Ranks”. Esto consiste a sumar todas las posiciones en que ha quedado un competidor en todas las categorías, y quién obtenga el número más bajo será quien mejor ha actuado a lo largo de toda la competición y, por tanto, el ganador.
​
The ACSC members will receive a 15% discount after the end of the competition. You can become a member of the ACSC [here](https://linktr.ee/speedcubingcat).

This competition does not have a main event. The winner of the competition will be decided through the “Sum of Ranks”. This consists of adding all the positions in which a competitor has remained in all categories, and the one who obtain the lowest number will be the one who has performed best throughout the competition and, therefore, the winner.

items.name: Rubik's UK Championship 2024
items.information:
## Welcome to Rubik's UK Championship 2024!
### This year's UK National Championship!

#### Please read ALL tabs before registering.

##### Spectators are welcome! Please read the information below, and the information in the [Guests, Spectators, and Media](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksUKChampionship2024#41928-guests-spectators-and-media) tab.

**Free T-Shirt:** By registering and attending Rubik's UK Championship 2024, you'll receive a Rubik's UK Championship 2024 T-shirt as a memento! **Please fill in your registration comment with your T-shirt size.**


**Guests:** A fee of £5 for a guest wristband will be due for all spectators and competitors' guests. They will be available on the door, payable via cash or card. Competitors will receive lanyards, and their guests and spectators will receive wristbands, which are to be worn throughout the weekend for security reasons. **This includes parents/guardians of competitors.** Please note that the guest field in the registration form is for informational purposes only.

**Newcomers:** Unfortunately, **this competition is not open to first-time competitors**. If you have not been to a competition before but would like to attend this one, you must attend another competition first. You can see all upcoming UK competitions [here](https://wca.ukca.org).

**Qualification Requirements:** If you do not meet the qualification requirements outlined in the [Events tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksUKChampionship2024#competition-events) in an official WCA competition by October 22nd you will not be eligible to compete in those events. You will not be able to add events to your registration which you do not qualify for, but can update your registration if you later qualify for them. Please note that **the only qualification for 2x2, 3x3, Pyraminx, and Skewb is to have any average in the event.**

**Final Round Advancements:** For all events with more than one round, we will be taking a minimum number of UK competitors to the final. If necessary, we will increase the size of the final by one competitor at a time until we have enough UK competitors. The requirements are as follows: 2x2, 4x4, 5x5, 6x6, 7x7, 3x3 Blindfolded, 3x3 One-Handed, Clock, Megaminx, Pyraminx, Skewb, Square-1: 6 UK competitors; 3x3: 8 UK competitors. 3x3 Multiple Blindfolded has a Top 16 qualification requirement, similarly this must contain at least 6 UK competitors.

**Fewest Moves:** FMC will **not** be held at this competition. To compete for the national champion title for FMC, you must compete at [Rubik's UK Championship FMC 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksUKChampionshipFMC2024). The winner of the FMC competition will be awarded their prize during the awards at Rubik's UK Championship 2024.

**Please Note:** As this is the UK National Championship, only competitors who represent the United Kingdom will be eligible for prizes. The competition remains open for all nationalities to compete.

items.information:
***English version is below***

**Deutsch:**
Wir freuen uns sehr euch Vienna Autumn 2024 als ein offizielles WCA Turnier ankündigen zu können.

Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von Simon Praschl, Thomas Strasser, Martin Fröhlich und Jeremia Neuhold und delegiert von Florian Truckenthanner und Pranjal Khan. Erneut findet das Turnier im großen Saal der Akkonplatz Pfarre statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt.

Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen!

Jeder Teilnehmer darf einen Gast mitbringen.

Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich!

**English:**
We are happy to announce the Vienna Autumn 2024 as an official WCA Competition.

The speedcubing competition is organised by Simon Praschl, Thomas Strasser, Martin Fröhlich and Jeremia Neuhold and delegated by Florian Truckenthanner und Pranjal Khan. Results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings.

The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations.

Every Competitor can bring one guest.

Hay un límite de 100 competidores para el registro.

* Leer el [Reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) para evitar posibles inconvenientes.
* Esta competencia está abierta a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad, cualquier edad y a nuevos competidores, sin importar sus tiempos de resolución.
* **COMPETIDORES NUEVOS**: deben leer [Importante](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NacionalesUruguayas2024#45609-importante-read) y [Competidores nuevos](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NacionalesUruguayas2024#45610-competidores-nuevos-newcomers).
* Se debe tener en cuenta que los competidores pueden ser descalificados en los casos que prevé el Reglamento de la WCA. No se realizan reembolsos de ningún tipo por descalificación, según el artículo [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1).
* Los competidores deben llevar sus propios puzzles.
* Los competidores tienen que estar presentes y listos para competir cuando se los llama, de no ser así, se penalizará al competidor con la descalificación del evento (de la ronda, no de toda la competencia), de acuerdo con el artículo [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) del reglamento.
* Es importante leer toda la información disponible en la página de la competencia.

Ante cualquier duda consultar a los organizadores o a los delegados de la WCA.

* Competitors must bring their own puzzles.

###### Español
¡**Silence in Nayarit 2024**! La primera competencia oficial en Nayarit especializada en eventos silenciosos se llevará a cabo en la ciudad de Tepic el sábado 21 y domingo 22 de septiembre de 2024.

Silence in Nayarit 2024 reunirá a cuberos de todo el estado de Nayarit y más allá, brindándoles la oportunidad de mostrar su destreza y competir en los eventos oficiales más difíciles. Tanto si eres un principiante como un profesional experimentado, este torneo ofrece una oportunidad para que todos demuestren sus habilidades.

La competencia incluirá una ronda de 3x3x3 Team-Blind, un evento no oficial que promete ser muy emocionante.

Además, esta competencia está reconocida oficialmente por la Asociación Mundial del Cubo (WCA). Por lo tanto, es importante que todos los competidores estén familiarizados con el reglamento de la WCA antes de la competencia.

###### English
**Silence in Nayarit 2024**! The first official competition in Nayarit specialized in silent events will be held in the city of Tepic on Saturday, September 21, and Sunday, September 22, 2024.

Silence in Nayarit 2024 will bring together cubers from all over the state of Nayarit and beyond, providing them with the opportunity to showcase their skills and compete in the most challenging official events. Whether you are a beginner or an experienced professional, this tournament offers a chance for everyone to demonstrate their abilities.

The competition will include a 3x3x3 Team-Blind round, an unofficial event that promises to be very exciting.

Additionally, this competition is officially recognized by the World Cube Association (WCA). Therefore, it is important that all competitors familiarize themselves with the WCA regulations before the competition.

items.information:
## SPECTATORS

Competitors are welcome to bring up to **two** spectators with them.

## VOLUNTEERING

Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8).

If any parents are willing to help judge or run, please watch the above video if you have not been a judge/runner at previous competitions. We greatly appreciate all assistance during the competition and more volunteers helping out during the competition helps to stay on schedule and not run behind.

## SPONSORSHIP
A big thanks to Cubestuff who are sponsoring the prizes for this competition. They will have a stall set up at the venue for you to buy the different speedcubes they have on offer.
You can also go to [Cubestuff.co.za](https://Cubestuff.co.za) to order a variety of cubes and equipment online.
A big thanks to Kitchen Nuvo for sponsoring trophies for our podium placers! Check them out on their Facebook page (https://www.facebook.com/worldfocuswood?mibextid=LQQJ4d) to give some support.

#### About CubingZA

Competitions in South Africa have exploded since the end of COVID, and interest is only getting stronger. CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country.

items.name: Qualifying in Kirstenhof 2024
items.information:
[CubingZA](https://www.cubingza.org/about) is excited to announce a new Cape Town competition for 2024. This competition is designed as a warmup/rankings qualifier for the [African Championships] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksWCAAfricanChampionship2024) that is coming up in September, so we will have plenty of events and plenty of rounds. Don't forget that to participate you need to register for the competition in the "Register" tab, **and** make payment by buying a ticket. Please see **Registration Requirements** below."
​
## CHANGES TO THE FORMAT
​
We are wanting to maximise the opportunities for all the cubers in our community and as a result we have decided to make the qualifying criteria for second rounds and finals to be much more achievable. Our goal is to have more people competing in more rounds of solving!!
​
### SPECTATORS
​
Competitors are welcome to bring 2 spectators with them. Please let us know if you need to accommodate more spectators.
​
### VOLUNTEERING
​
Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be allocated prior to the event and explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). 
​
### LUCKY DRAW
​
During prize-giving after 3x3 Finals on Sunday, we will be having a Lucky Draw for two winners to receive R250 Speedcubes.co.za vouchers each with free shipping on their order! If you needed another reason to stick around and watch 3x3 Finals other than the amazing speed of some of Africa's top speedcubers, maybe you could be one of the lucky winners and walk away with some free cubes or apparel courtesy of our local speedcubing store.
​

## 🇳🇴 Informasjon
Velkommen til Norgesmesterskapet i Kubing 2024, for første gang holdt i Sandnes! Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta, uavhengig av nasjonalitet.

### Førstegangsdeltakere
Førstegangsdeltakere er veldig velkommen til å delta på NM. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. Vi ber alle førstegangsdeltakere vennligst lese [Førstegangsdeltakere-fanen](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorwegianChampionship2024#39270-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors).

### Staffing
Vi kommer til å trenge frivillige som kan bidra med ulike oppgaver under arrangementet. De som bidrar på dette teamet vil få ulike goder, blant annet refundert registreringsavgift. Les [Staffing-fanen](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorwegianChampionship2024#39280-staffing) for mer info.

---

## 🇬🇧 Information
Welcome to the Norwegian Cubing Championship of 2024, held in Sandnes for the first time. The competition is open to all who wish to compete regardless of nationality.

### First-Time Competitors
First-time competitors are very welcome to compete in the Norwegian Championship. There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition. We would like to ask all first-time competitors to read the [First-Time Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorwegianChampionship2024#39270-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors) tab.

### Staffing

Chào mừng các bạn đến với giải đấu vô địch quốc gia Vietnam Championship 2024! Giải Vietnam Championship lần này sẽ có toàn bộ các bộ môn thi đấu, với nhiều môn thi đấu có từ 2 đến 4 vòng.
Xem thêm thông tin tại các tab.

# Điều kiện tham dự thi Giải bịt mắt 4x4x4 và Giải bịt mắt 5x5x5

Các thí sinh tham dự các nội dung **Giải bịt mắt 4x4x4 và Giải bịt mắt 5x5x5** phải đạt điều kiện sau:
* Thí sinh phải có **ít nhất một lượt** Giải bịt mắt 3x3x3 thành công.
* Kết quả Giải bịt mắt 3x3x3 tốt nhất của thí sinh đạt **Top 20** trong số các thí sinh đã đăng ký thi nội dung tương ứng.
Các thí sinh không đạt những điều kiện này sẽ **không được tham dự thi** các nội dung tương ứng và sẽ được hoàn 100% lệ phí các môn này (nếu đã nộp).
# Thông cáo về quay phim chụp ảnh

Ban tổ chức và/hoặc các hãng truyền thông tại giải đấu có thể sẽ quay phim, chụp ảnh làm tư liệu về giải đấu. Bằng cách có mặt tại hội trường giải đấu, **bạn công nhận rằng bạn đã được thông báo về việc quay phim, chụp ảnh tại giải đấu, và hiểu rõ rằng tư liệu hình ảnh này sẽ được sử dụng cho mọi mục đích cần thiết của Hiệp hội Rubik Việt Nam, các tổ chức đại diện và các đối tác, nhà tài trợ liên quan. Bạn đồng thời cũng đồng ý cho phép Hiệp hội Rubik Việt Nam, các tổ chức đại diện và các đối tác, nhà tài trợ liên quan toàn quyền vĩnh viễn sử dụng những hình ảnh có diện mạo và/hoặc giọng nói của bạn cho mọi mục đích cần thiết.** Nếu bạn không đồng ý với các điều khoản trên, xin vui lòng không có mặt tại hội trường giải đấu.
________________________________________________________________
We warmly welcome you to Vietnam Championships 2024! This year's Vietnam Championship will offer all events, many of which will be offering 2 to 4 rounds.
Refer to the tabs for more information.

# Qualification Criteria for 4x4x4 Blindfolded and 5x5x5 Blindfolded
Competitors in **4x4x4 Blindfolded and 5x5x5 Blindfolded** must meet the following qualification criteria:
* The competitor must have **at least one** successful 3x3x3 Blindfolded result.
* The competitor's best 3x3x3 Blindfolded result must be within the **Top 20** of all registered competitors of the respective event.
Competitors who fail to meet these criteria will **not be allowed to compete in the respective event** and will receive a full refund of any event fees for the events (if already paid).

# Notice on Filming and Photography
The organizers and/or present media companies may perform filming and photography at the competition for usage as photographic material of the competition. By being present at the competition premises,  **you acknowledge that you have been duly informed of any filming and photography that might take place at the competition, and fully acknowledge that the material may be used for any and all necessary purposes by the Vietnam Cube Association (VNCA) and its representatives, partners and affiliated sponsors. You also grant full, perpetual consent for VNCA and its representatives, partners and affiliated sponsors to use video and photographic material that contains your likeness and/or voice for any and all necessary purposes.** If you do not agree with the above terms, please do not be present at the competition premises.

items.name: Please Be Clocked Cape Town 2024
items.information:
## Information

[CubingZA](https://www.cubingza.org/about) is excited to announce Please Be Clocked Cape Town 2024! This competition has a full array of blindfolded events, with Clock and 5x5 to mix things up. 
Don't forget that to participate you need to register for the competition in the "Register" tab, and make payment by buying a ticket. Please see payment details below. **Important** - if we do not have enough competitors to hold 3x3 Blindfolded Round 2, we will adjust the schedule to have 2 Rounds of 5x5 instead.

**PLEASE NOTE** This competition does NOT have 3x3 or other popular events like 2x2 or Pyraminx. If you are a newcomer, please do not register unless you are able to solve cubes Blindfolded or would like to participate in the 5x5 or Clock events.

## SPECTATORS

Spectators are only allowed as companions to competitors.

## VOLUNTEERING

Please note that all competitors are required to assist with **volunteering** during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler".

If any competitor or competitor's guests are willing to help judge with the blindfolded events, especially Multiple Blindfolded, please let us know. If you are able to assist with judging the longer events (4x4 Blindfolded, 5x5 Blindfolded, and Multiple Blindfolded), we will reward you with a free coffee, chocolate, or other small gift :)

#### About CubingZA

CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country. If you are able to assist in any way and want to get involved, please get in touch [here](https://cubingza.org/contact)!

items.name: Oslo Open 2024
items.information:
## Informasjon

Norsk:

Velkommen til Oslo Open 2024!
Alle er velkommen, enten du løser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minutter. Du trenger heller ingen tidligere erfaring med kubekonkurranser. 
Du melder deg på konkurransen online. Hvis du ikke har en WCA konto må du først lage en [her](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/users/sign_up). 

Deltakeravgiften inkluderer lunsj på lørdag og søndag og snacks fredag kveld. 
Det blir salgsstand med salg av Oslo Open T-shirts og Nordicube selger kuber og stæsj.
Lokalet har kiosk med salg av snacks, mat og drikke og T-shirt workshop der deltakere og besøkende kan trykke sin egen T-shirt.

Velkommen til en helg i Oslo med ulike aktiviteter for kubeinteresserte!

Det er kort vei til matbutikker og take-away-tilbud i nærområdet.

Hvis du er medlem i Norges Kubeforbund får du 50 kr tilbake. Alle betaler først full påmeldingsavgift og så refunderer vi 50 kr til medlemmer av NKF. Klikk her for informasjon om[ medlemskap i NKF](https://kubing.no/OmOss). 

## Information

English:

Welcome to Oslo Open 2024!
Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior cube competition experience.
You need to register for the competition online. If you don’t have a WCA account you can make one [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/users/sign_up).

The participation fee includes lunch on Saturday and Sunday, as well as snacks on Friday evening. 
There will be a sales booth offering Oslo Open T-shirts and Nordicube selling cubes and accessories.
The venue also has a kiosk selling snacks, food, and drinks, and a T-shirt workshop where participants and visitors can print their own T-shirt.

Welcome to a weekend in Oslo with various activities for cube enthusiasts!

There are several shops in the area selling food and take-away. 

If you are a member of Norges Kubeforbund we will refund 50 NOK. Everyone pays full price at first, and we will refund 50 NOK to members. For NKF membership, please visit [NKF's website kubing.no](https://kubing.no/OmOss)

### PORTUGUÊS

Sejam bem-vindos ao **Rio Cubolympics 2024**!
Será um prazer recebê-los.

**Dicas:**
- Chegue ao local da competição pelo menos **30 minutos** antes de **modalidade que participará**;
- O cubo que você irá competir deve estar em bom estado;
- Você é responsável pelo seu cubo e seus pertences, cuide deles. Não nos responsabilizamos por perda de cubos mágicos e outros pertences durante a competição;
- Se tiver alguma dúvida, não hesite em perguntar para a equipe de organização e delegados.

Mesmo que a nossa competição seja formada por alguns competidores experientes, sempre teremos espaço para novos cubistas.
Procure se divertir bastante!

### ENGLISH

Welcome to **Rio Cubolympics 2024**!
It will be a pleasure to welcome you.

**Tips:**
- Arrive at the competition location at least **30 minutes** before **the category you will participate in**;
- The cube you will compete with must be in good condition;
- You are responsible for your cube and your belongings, take care of them. We are not responsible for the loss of cubes and other belongings during the competition;
- If you have any questions, don't hesitate to ask the organization team and delegates.

Even though our competition is made up of some experienced competitors, we will always have room for new cubers.
Have a lot of fun!

items.information:
Välkomna till Svenska Mästerskapen 2024! 

Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter. 

Det blir i år en 3-dagarstävling med alla WCA-grenar utom en, 3x3x3 FMC. Den Svenska Mästaren i den grenen kommer krönas på den separata tävlingen [Swedish FMC Championship 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SwedishFMCChampionship2024).

Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information.

Tävlande av alla nationaliteter är välkomna, men bara deltagare som representerar Sverige kan vinna medaljer, priser och titeln Svensk Mästare.

-----

Welcome to the Swedish Championship 2024!

Everyone is welcome to participate, whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes.

This year there will be a 3-day competition with all WCA events but one, 3x3x3 FMC. The Swedish Champion in this event will be crowned at the separate competition [Swedish FMC Championship 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SwedishFMCChampionship2024).

We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information.

Competitors of all nationalities are welcome, but only participants representing Sweden can win medals, prizes and the title of Swedish Champion.

items.name: BF Vienna Day 2024
items.information:
##### *English version is below*

#### **Deutsch:**

Wir freuen uns sehr, euch BF Vienna Day 2024 als ein offizielles WCA Turnier ankündigen zu können. 

Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert und delegiert von Florian Truckenthanner und Viktor Kalmar. Diesesmal findet das Turnier in den Räumlichkeiten des BMME statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt.

Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier herzlich willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. 

Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich!

-----

#### **English:**

We are happy to announce the BF Vienna Day 2024 as an official WCA Competition. 

The speedcubing competition is organised and delegated by Florian Truckenthanner and Viktor Kalmar. The results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings.

The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations.
